raw_segments.text: Ophidius, I Mardius K.S. Mardius, dost thou think I'll grace thee with that robbery thy
You lords and heads o, T.H., state, perfidiously he has betrayed your business and given up
for certain drops of salt your city roam.
I say your city, to his wife and mother, breaking his oath and resolution like a twist of rotten
silk, never admitting counsel o, T.H., war, but at his nurse's tears he whined and roared
away your victory, that pages blushed at him and men of heart looked wondering each other.
